text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... The thing is, everyone in my
dorm got
together last night and
chatted away until really
late.
choice_data_list: もしかしてあまり休めなかった？
choice_data_list_en: Were you not able to rest much?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It was really fun. There were so many
interesting
stories, I was on the edge of
my seat the whole
time!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'd very much like to talk today as well,
but... I
guess... I might be a teensy bit
tired...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Clearly sleep deprived, Fine Motion
remains
drowsy all day.
